s0301.literal: On jiashen day Venus transgressed Dipper.
s0301.idiomatic: On jiashen day Venus transgressed Dipper.

s0302.literal: On gengyin day an edict directed that an Iron Smelting Intendant Office be established at Wutai Lingjiu Temple.
s0302.idiomatic: On gengyin day an edict directed that an iron smelting intendant office be established at Wutai Lingjiu Temple.

s0303.literal: On yiwei day Prince Bin Nanhuli's division was granted forty thousand ingots of notes.
s0303.idiomatic: On yiwei day Prince Bin Nanhuli's division was granted 40,000 ingots of notes.

s0304.literal: On dingyou day Ganzhou city was repaired.
s0304.idiomatic: On dingyou day Ganzhou city was repaired.

s0305.literal: An edict was announced forbidding commoners whose father is alive from privately lending money to others or selling tomb timber.
s0305.idiomatic: An edict was announced forbidding commoners whose father is alive from privately lending money to others or selling tomb timber.

s0306.literal: Ganzhou, Suzhou, and other routes suffered famine; land rent was remitted.
s0306.idiomatic: Ganzhou, Suzhou, and other routes suffered famine; land rent was remitted.

s0307.literal: Eleventh month, on renyin day, supervising censors were ordered to supervise the Lingbei audit of revenues and grain, with rotation every half year.
s0307.idiomatic: Eleventh month, on renyin day, supervising censors were ordered to supervise the Lingbei audit of revenues and grain, with rotation every half year.

s0308.literal: Mipu Yunji, abbot of Dawanning Temple, used the state duke seal he wore to issue documents to the regular authorities, disrupting official government; an edict forbade this.
s0308.idiomatic: Mipu Yunji, abbot of Dawanning Temple, used the state duke seal he wore to issue documents to the regular authorities, disrupting official government; an edict forbade this.

s0309.literal: On yisi day one post each of associate administrator, prefectural judge, supervisory controller, and clerical registrar was added at Jining, Shajing, and Jing routes.
s0309.idiomatic: On yisi day one post each of associate administrator, prefectural judge, supervisory controller, and clerical registrar was added at Jining, Shajing, and Jing routes.

s0310.literal: On yimao day the Former Grain Transport Intendant Office was renamed the Dadu Land Transport Intendant Office; the New Grain Transport Intendant Office was renamed the Capital Region Grain Transport Intendant Office; and the Lizhou Route Pacification Commission was renamed the Anding Military-Civilian Prefecture.
s0310.idiomatic: On yimao day the former grain transport intendant office was renamed the Dadu land transport intendant office; the new grain transport intendant office was renamed the capital region grain transport intendant office; and the Lizhou Route pacification commission was renamed the Anding Military-Civilian Prefecture.

s0311.literal: Twelfth month, on gengwu day, Tuhulu, privy council director, was made left grand councillor of the Shaanxi branch secretariat.
s0311.idiomatic: Twelfth month, on gengwu day, Tuhulu, privy council director, was made left grand councillor of the Shaanxi branch secretariat.

s0312.literal: On renwu day Zhang Sicheng, thirty-ninth-generation successor Han Celestial Master, was granted the title Great Perfect Man of Supreme Mystery, Assisting Transformation, Embodying Benevolence, and Responding to the Way and put in charge of the Three Mountains talismans, administering Jiangnan Daoist affairs.
s0312.idiomatic: On renwu day Zhang Sicheng, thirty-ninth-generation successor Han Celestial Master, was granted the title Great Perfect Man of Supreme Mystery, Assisting Transformation, Embodying Benevolence, and Responding to the Way and put in charge of the Three Mountains talismans, administering Jiangnan Daoist affairs.

s0313.literal: On dinghai day Prince Shidebala was installed as crown prince, concurrently central secretariat chancellor and privy council commissioner; he received the gold seal and treasure, and announcement was made to Heaven, Earth, and the ancestral temples.
s0313.idiomatic: On dinghai day Prince Shidebala was installed as crown prince, concurrently central secretariat chancellor and privy council commissioner; he received the gold seal and treasure, and announcement was made to Heaven, Earth, and the ancestral temples.

s0314.literal: Associate privy council director Chuangwu'er was promoted to privy council director.
s0314.idiomatic: Associate privy council director Chuangwu'er was promoted to privy council director.

s0315.literal: Prince Anhui's division lacked food; three thousand one hundred eighty-six shi of grain were granted in relief.
s0315.idiomatic: Prince Anhui's division lacked food; 3,186 shi of grain were granted in relief.
